title: Coalesce Identical In-Flight LLM Requests
signature: class Coalescer: __init__(loop, upstream), call(request) -> generator returning the response
hints: Keep a dict from key to the Task running the one upstream call. The first caller spawns it; everyone, including the first caller, waits with `yield task`.
The key must include the tenant. Two customers sending the same prompt must never share a response. Use json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True) so dict key order doesn't matter.
Remove the key when the upstream call settles, on success and on failure, inside the spawned task (try/finally). Otherwise a later request reuses a stale answer or a cached error.
Requests with temperature > 0 bypass the coalescer completely.
